name: EU Space Act
memo_monitoring:
• Implementation plans and monitoring, evaluation and reporting arrangements
The specific objectives of the initiative would be monitored on an annual basis. The proposal would be evaluated five years after it has entered into force to assess the impact on and reaction of the market, in particular SMEs.
